# `xpath_boolean`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if the XPath expression evaluates to true, or if a matching node is found.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
xpath_boolean(xml, xpath)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `xml_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- xpath_boolean, example 1
> SELECT xpath_boolean('<a><b>1</b></a>','a/b');
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.0.0.
